segments.text:
THE principall queſtions are,
1 Whether there be a God.
2 What hee is, or what manner of God hee is whom wee woorſhip, and in what hee differeth from Idols.
3 Whence it may appeare that there is but one God.
4 What the names of Eſſence, Perſon, and Trinitie, ſignifie.
5 In what the Eſſence differeth from the perſon.
6 Whether theſe names are to bee vſed in the Church, and whether they are had in the Scripture.
7 Howe manie perſons there bee of the godheade.
8 Howe theſe differ one from another.
9 For what cauſe this doctrine is to bee helde in the Church.
